conventions: Match the existing style of each file: consistency within a package beats consistency across the repo (CLAUDE.md).

Prettier is the formatter (config @backstage/cli/config/prettier): single quotes, trailing commas, arrowParens avoid, 80 columns, 2-space indent; every changed file is formatted with yarn prettier --write <path>.
Every edited .ts/.tsx/.js file keeps its existing Apache 2.0 copyright header and year unchanged; no new source files are created (changesets are markdown and carry no header).
Change only the lines a unit's sites name; do not reorder imports, rename symbols or touch unrelated code.
package.json edits: keep 2-space JSON indentation and key order; keep a trailing comma exactly when another entry follows in the same object; never touch peerDependenciesMeta or react-router-dom.
React APIs are imported by name: import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'; import { useMemo, useSyncExternalStore } from 'react'.
Tests run on Jest 30 through backstage-cli (CI=1 yarn test <path> from the repo root), with describe/it, expect matchers and React Testing Library.

Changesets are new .changeset/<kebab-name>.md files: YAML front matter of '<package-name>': <bump> lines (single-quoted names, one per line, sorted by name), a blank line, then a plain-language adopter-facing message; never name internal symbols (functions, variables, env flags).
A breaking changeset message starts with **BREAKING**: (bold, then a colon), as existing changesets in .changeset/ do.
Docs follow docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md: present tense, active voice, address the reader as you, no statements about the future, code style for package names and file paths.
No yarn build, yarn release or changesets version; no commits; only write-contract allowlisted paths change; yarn.lock is written only by yarn install.

decisions.choice: Exactly "^18.0.0" for @types/react, react and react-dom in peerDependencies of every listed package; react-router-dom stays "^6.30.2"; devDependencies stay as they are (@types/react ^18.0.0, react and react-dom ^18.0.2).
rejected: ^18.0.2 (devDependency pin, stricter than needed for peers)
decisions.reason: Matches @backstage/ui, which is already React 18 only, and the single expected range the peer-deps lint enforces after this change.

decisions.topic: How the three render sites mount
decisions.choice: Static named import `import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client';` replacing the `import 'react-dom';` side-effect line (or the dynamic import block), then a direct synchronous `createRoot(container).render(node)` call; no promise, no process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT branch.
rejected: default import ReactDOM from 'react-dom/client' (createDevApp.test.tsx mocks react-dom/client with only a named createRoot export, so ReactDOM.createRoot would be undefined)
keeping the dynamic import() promise (it only existed to avoid resolving react-dom/client under React 17)
decisions.reason: React 18 is required, so react-dom/client always resolves; the named import works with both the real module and the existing jest.doMock in createDevApp.test.tsx.

decisions.choice: config.ts defines 'process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT': JSON.stringify(true) in both the webpack and the rspack DefinePlugin branches; cli-module-test-jest/config/jest.js sets process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT = true unconditionally at the same spot the try/catch was.
rejected: dropping the define entirely (already published plugin builds read the flag and would silently fall back to ReactDOM.render)
keeping require.resolve detection (React 17 is no longer supported)
decisions.reason: Keeps older published packages on their createRoot path while removing the detection code (FR-6, brief goal 4).

decisions.choice: A tooling unit runs `rm packages/cli-module-build/src/lib/bundler/hasReactDomClient.ts` from the project root after config.ts and startFrontend.ts stop importing it.
rejected: an edit that empties the file (the file would still exist, failing AC-4)
git rm (stages the change in the index; the run makes no commits or index changes)
decisions.reason: The spec has no delete action for a typed unit; a tooling step is the only way to remove a file, and it is shown at Gate 2.

decisions.topic: CLI React version warning in server.ts
decisions.choice: checkReactVersion keeps its try/catch and require.resolve of react/package.json from targetPaths.rootDir; it reads `const major = parseInt(reactPkg.version, 10);` and when `major < 18` prints one console.log(chalk.yellow(...)) with the text: You are using React ${reactPkg.version}, which is no longer supported by Backstage. Please upgrade your app to React 18 by following the migration guide: https://backstage.io/docs/tutorials/react18-migration/
rejected: adding a semver dependency to cli-module-build (a new dependency for a single major comparison)
console.warn (the existing check in this function uses console.log with chalk.yellow)
a boxed multi-line warning (the box cannot stay aligned with a dynamic version string)
decisions.reason: One warning when the app's React major is below 18, linking to the React 18 migration guide (FR-8); a NaN major never warns because NaN < 18 is false.

decisions.choice: Typed edit of the generated report, not a regeneration: drop the react-dom row that points at the deleted file, change the heading count to (1), and realign the table to its remaining row as knip's markdown reporter does (column width = longest cell); the react row keeps its location text src/lib/bundler/server.ts:274:43 unchanged.
rejected: running yarn build:knip-reports (it rewrites reports beyond this package's change and is not checked in CI)
decisions.reason: FR-6 requires only that the report no longer points at the deleted file; the report is prettier-ignored and generated, so the edit reproduces the generator's table format by hand.

decisions.topic: Files left untouched although listed in the brief
rejected: editing render.test.tsx (it renders through build() and React Testing Library and never touches the removed fallback)
editing report.api.md (API Extractor reports carry the release tag and the type, not the doc comment text, so the LegacyRootOption comment change does not alter it)
decisions.reason: A refactor changes only what the requirement needs; both files stay consistent with the change as they are.

decisions.choice: Six new files: react-18-required-major.md (major, the 17 published packages at >=1.0.0 whose peer range narrows), react-18-required-minor.md (minor, the 37 published packages below 1.0.0 whose peer range narrows), react-18-drop-sync-external-store-shim.md (patch: @backstage/ui, @backstage/frontend-plugin-api, @backstage/plugin-app), react-18-cli-module-build.md (patch), react-18-cli-module-test-jest.md (patch), react-18-repo-tools-peer-deps.md (minor, breaking for a 0.x package).
rejected: one changeset for every package (messages must be relevant to every package they name)
editing existing changesets (none of the 42 existing ones cover React peer ranges or these CLI changes)
decisions.reason: CLAUDE.md: breaking below 1.0.0 is minor, at or above 1.0.0 is major; private app-example-plugin and @internal/plugin-todo-list get none; changesets merges a patch entry into a larger bump of the same package.
